subject: Re: Kickoff: private instruction data for alignment (dp_instructions)
body:
Status. End-to-end pipeline milestone: hit, three days late. DP fine-tuning of the 7B at epsilon=8 converged cleanly; the 13B needed the batch size doubled to keep the signal-to-noise workable, which Amara absorbed with gradient accumulation on the existing titan allocation.

Quality signal so far: after the DP histogram resampling step, the synthetic instruction distribution matches the real corpus much better on topic coverage — the initial (unresampled) synthetic set over-represents short generic requests, exactly what the resampling is designed to fix. SFT on the labeled pairs recovers 94% of the instruction-following win-rate of the non-private baseline.

Risk: the labeling stage is our schedule long pole. Linnea's annotation throughput is capped and the label queue for the eval set is 9 days deep. If it's still backed up next week we should discuss trimming the eval set before the RLHF leg starts in June.

Hyun
